response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
